GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2024-05-20T02:52:53Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Here’s the issue we encountered with `redisson-3.11.5.jar`
Description: 
Our service connects to the SLB (Server Load Balancer) using a domain name, which maps through a port to the Redis server nodes.

For example:
- Service IP --> Domain A:2700 --> EIP (10.75.10.20):27000 --> Redis server: 10.65.10.30:27000

The Redis sentinel nodes are:
- 10.65.10.30:27000
- 10.65.10.40:27000
- 10.65.10.50:27000

Redisson performs two types of checks: `scheduleSentinelDNSCheck` and `scheduleChangeCheck`. These checks result in the following situations:

- `redis://10.75.10.20:27000 added`
- `redis://10.75.10.20:27000 was down`
- `redis://10.65.10.30:27000 added`
- `redis://10.65.10.30:27000 was down`

This causes a polling effect, even though they ultimately point to the correct sentinel nodes.

### How to Resolve This Issue
